name: Second-order Grid Sampler
aliases: Hessian computation for SDF via double backprop
Second-order Grid Sampler — Hessian computation for SDF via double backprop
Second-order derivative computation for SDF regularization
definition: An implementation of a grid sampler in PyTorch that allows double backpropagation to compute second-order derivatives (Hessian) of the Signed Distance Field (SDF) with respect to 3D query coordinates, feature grid parameters, and geometry network parameters, avoiding the usage of higher-order tensors.
summary: The Second-order Grid Sampler computes exact Hessian matrices for Signed Distance Fields via double back-propagation, distinguishing itself from finite-difference methods by deriving analytical second-order derivatives of the learned interpolation function.
